tools_helpful.evidence: Once the correct anchor 'capture' was found (turn 34), it returned the full CaptureElement -> Image + SoftwareBitmapSource recipe which the agent implemented verbatim to a passing result (score 100).
The '### CS0246 / WMC0001: CaptureElement could not be found' entry correctly told the agent NOT to defer the camera page and to use the frame-pump pattern; final parity was a pass.

tools_problematic.problem: On an unknown anchor it prints only 'Anchor #<x> not found' with no list of valid anchors, so the agent cannot recover except by guessing again or opening the whole file.
tools_problematic.evidence: Turns 30-33: agent guessed -Anchor media (fail), -Anchor camera-preview (fail), then had to Select-String the '## ' headings and grep CaptureElement before finding the real anchor is 'capture'.

tool_limitations.limitation: Matches ONLY exact '<a id="...">' anchors; many '## ' sections in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md have no <a id> at all (e.g. 'Common build errors', 'Namespace Mapping', 'Resources: MRT', 'Text Rendering', 'Test Projects') and are therefore unreachable by the helper, forcing a full-file open that the script's own docstring warns trips the content-safety filter.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: On not-found, list all available anchors + their heading text; accept case-insensitive substring matches against both anchor ids and heading text as a fallback.

special_apis.special_handling: Not available in WinUI 3. Replace with <Image> whose Source is a SoftwareBitmapSource pumped from MediaCapture.GetPreviewFrameAsync (Bgra8 + Premultiplied). Do NOT defer the camera page. Covered at MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#capture.

errors_encountered.root_cause: CaptureElement is a UWP-only XAML control with no WinUI 3 equivalent element.
errors_encountered.fix: Replaced with <Image x:Name=PreviewImage> + SoftwareBitmapSource frame pump per MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#capture. Resolved to a passing preview.

dev_agent_struggles.where: Resolving the CaptureElement build error via Get-MigrationPattern.ps1
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: 3 failed anchor lookups before finding the right section
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: turns 30-34 (guessed 'media', 'camera-preview'; both errored; then listed headings + grepped before finding 'capture')
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 gives no discoverability on failure: it neither lists valid anchors nor matches on heading text, and the anchor id 'capture' is not guessable from the UWP term 'camera preview'.

dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Make Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 print the full anchor+heading list on not-found and accept case-insensitive substring matches against anchor ids and heading text.
